scope: Residual RL over an observed route-bearing action prior, 500K x 3 seeds from EXP40 500K (actor mean head zeroed, so training starts exactly at the prior). Selection on the validation split, sealed test once; the prior alone (zeroed policy) is sealed-tested once as the controller-only baseline.
authorization: User 2026-10-01 ~23:00: continue research overnight, aim to exceed 80 percent by morning, other methods than this network form allowed.
transition_unit: one environment control step, not individual robot samples
comparability: New method track (structured policy). Reported separately from pure RL; compared on the same sealed test layouts to EXP39/EXP40 and to the prior alone.
task_limit: Controlled in-vitro goal-conditioned ideal-actuator simulation with perfect state. All object positions randomized on fixed MCA anatomy. Soft overlap costs, not hard collision physics. Diagnostic clearance feasibility is not collision-free policy performance or hardware verification.
dashboard_message: EXP41 路由先验+残差RL：执行=观测到的自身路由方位+0.5×策略输出（非纯RL）。
study_stage: Formal 500K paired study; validation split for selection, sealed test (500 layouts) for the reported result.
bundled_variables: Action prior plus residual scale 0.5, single method change.

checkpoint_selection.rule: Pick the milestone with the highest complete-clearance rate on the 200 registered validation layouts (configs/evaluation_splits.json); ties go to the earlier milestone. The parent (0 steps) is a candidate.

sealed_test.report: Final claims use only sealed-test results; 940000000-940000099 is diagnostic only.
